angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 338,806 km at 196.19 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0971 +/- 0.0417 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 196.19 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.487 +/- 0.013 solar radii from O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract): 338,806 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.518 +/- 0.023 solar masses from O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3541 +/- 59 K from O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5916.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.777, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5916 (pscomppars): spectral type M2, from O'Brien et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TIC 305506996: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5916 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.04 dex, from O'Brien et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5916 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.45717, from O'Brien et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5916 (pscomppars): age 5 Gyr, from Dransfield et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.547ag448D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5916 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from O'Brien et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
